column1: # compile-speed baseline: SWI inference counts per .dl6 program per
# Gate bands: fail above baseline*1.10, fail below
# Written 2026-07-31T02:55:02Z on arm64 SWI-Prolog version 10.0.2 for arm64-darwin
# The three parse rows below sit ABOVE the counts from before parse_dl.pl
# tracked furthest-failure positions, and that is deliberate. mark_furthest/1
# runs at every whitespace stop, every literal match and every token entry --
# 12,723 calls parsing golden-flex -- and a Prolog call costs one inference
# before its body does anything, so no tracker that still reports a
# furthest-failure line:column fits inside a 10% band around counts taken when
# nothing was tracked. door-handwritten's parse row is deliberately NOT reset:
# at 960 bytes the same tracker still lands inside the band.
